adapter.candidate_text: exact V2 normalized title, abstract and MeSH concatenation
adapter.comparator_input: two logical fields: normalized original title; normalized original abstract followed by MeSH with pipe separators replaced by spaces
adapter.labels: binary include/exclude labels are retained exactly
adapter.warm_seed: exact V2 included seed followed by exact V2 excluded seed
adapter.why_terminal_preserving: The adapter changes only field packaging. It does not merge, drop, infer or relabel include/exclude terminals, and both candidate and comparators receive the same record universe, labels, text fields and warm seed.

audit_boundary: The candidate outcome was already known. Only the two registered active-comparator outcomes were unopened at freeze. This execution is a post-outcome one-pool robustness audit, never confirmation or generalization evidence.

comparator_execution.ASREVIEW_ELAS_U3_CADENCE_MATCHED: Pinned u3 NB, TF-IDF, balanced ratio 1.2 and max-query components; deterministic stable ranking; batches of 52 instead of the ASReview application default of one.
comparator_execution.ASREVIEW_ELAS_U4_CADENCE_MATCHED: Pinned default u4 LinearSVC, TF-IDF, balanced ratio 9.8 and max-query components; explicit random_state 20260823 and deterministic stable ranking; batches of 52 instead of the ASReview application default of one.
comparator_execution.balanced_weight: Exact pinned ASReview formula: positive weight 1, negative weight n_positive/(ratio*n_negative), followed by normalization to total sample count.
comparator_execution.complete_order: Fit on all screened labels, rank every unscreened record by the frozen active score with stable identity tie-break, reveal the next full batch, and repeat until the population is ordered.
comparator_execution.fairness: Both comparator configurations are fixed before outcome access and the candidate is compared with their endpoint-wise maximum; all three active arms receive the same labels, seed, text fields, record universe and 52-record feedback cadence.

determinism.ranking: numpy stable argsort of descending score over ascending identity pool
determinism.vectorizers: fitted once on the full unlabeled text population, as in the V2 transductive representation rule and pinned ASReview simulation pattern

metric_implementation.fraction_screened_at_95_recall: one-indexed position of the ceil(0.95*total_included)-th inclusion divided by N
metric_implementation.recall_budget_rounding: ceil(fraction*N), inclusive of the two warm seeds
